User guide

The kinetren user guide, in English. It is the editor's own documentation, docs/guide in the source repository, as of v26.10.25.1.

  1. Getting started

    This page takes you from an empty window to an exported MP4. For installation see the Install in the README.

  2. The timeline

    Video tracks are layers: the top track is drawn over the ones below it. Audio tracks are mixed. Morph tracks hold morphers. Every track has a name (right-click the header → Rename track…), mute, solo and lock, its own effects, opacity and blend mode (the track window, from the same menu). Drag a header to reorder tracks; drag its bottom edge to change its height, right-click the edge to reset it. Shift+wheel scrolls tracks, Ctrl+Shift+wheel changes all track heights.

  3. Effects and automation

    Double-click an event (or choose Effects… in its menu) to open its effects window. A linked pair opens as one window with a section for the picture and one for the sound.

  4. Reels and generators

    Select events and choose Edit → Collapse selection into a reel. The events become one reel event that you can place, trim, slow down and reuse like any clip. Every instance plays the same reel, so editing the reel updates all of them; a ×N badge shows how many places use it.

  5. The morpher

    A morpher is an event on a morph track that changes the events under it for as long as it lasts — an adjustment layer for both picture and sound.

  6. Export and kt-cli

    File → Render to MP4… (or the render button) exports the region, or the whole project when no region is set.

  7. Keyboard and mouse

    The status line always shows what the thing under the mouse does.
